Question: Assalmualaikum Janaab Allah gift me a son (31 march 2009 evening b/w 4pm 5pm). I want a good name with better meaning. please tell me. my wife name is Juwariya Rizvi. I wait your mail. if i have any mistake in written skills so sorry. Answer ID: 12457 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1057/828=H/1430) May Allah grant your son long life, honour, knowledge and the blessings of both the worlds, Amen! Choose any of these three names: Muhammad Ameen, Zainul Abideen, Ziaul Islam ( محمد امین، زین العابدین، ضیاء الاسلام ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
